data.keyword: What is the current LTS version of Node.js?

result.keyword: What is the current LTS version of Node.js?

items.markdown:
The current Long-Term Support (LTS) version of Node.js is **Node.js 26** (specifically version **26.13.0** , codenamed **"Lithium"**).[[1]](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v26.13.0)

### Key Details for Node.js 26 (LTS)

- **Codename:** Lithium
- **Active LTS Support:** Through the end of April 2029
- **Official Downloads:** Available directly via the Node.js Downloads Page or through your preferred version manager (like `nvm` or `fnm`).
- **Release Notes:** Read the full announcement on the [Node.js 26.13.0 LTS Release Blog](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v26.13.0).[[1]](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v26.13.0)

Would you like help checking the **migration guide** from a previous LTS version (like Node.js 24 or 22) or finding out which **features** were introduced in Node.js 26?
